items.title: 17.4 Thermal Decomposition of Carbonates and Nitrates (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 17.4 with Quick Check 17.2 answered, printed pages 5-7. The answers were written for this lesson and need review.

blocks.text: Thermal decomposition woh chemical reaction hai jis mein ek hi compound garam karne par do ya zyada saada (simpler) maddon mein toot jata hai. Compound ke andar ke chemical bonds torne ke liye is mein aam taur par energy deni parti hai, yani yeh endothermic (garmi lene wala) hota hai.

Group 2 ke carbonates aur nitrates ko samajhne aur parakhne ke liye thermal decomposition bohat kaam ka hai, kyunke in ki thermal stability (garmi mein na tootne ki salahiyat) group mein neeche ek saaf trend dikhati hai.

Group 2 carbonates garam karne par toot kar metal oxide (MO) aur carbon dioxide gas (CO₂) banate hain. Carbonates ki thermal stability group mein neeche barhti hai. Matlab BeCO₃ MgCO₃ se kam temperature par toot'ta hai, MgCO₃ CaCO₃ se kam temperature par, aur isi tarah aage.
BaCO₃ ko tootne ke liye sab se zyada temperature chahiye.

Is trend ki wajah M²⁺ ion ka size hai. Chhote aur zyada charge wale cations (jaise Be²⁺) ki "polarizing power" (anion ke electron badal ko apni taraf kheench kar bigarne ki taqat) zyada hoti hai. Yeh bare carbonate ion (CO₃²⁻) ko zyada bigar (distort) dete hain, us ke bonds kamzor kar dete hain, aur garmi se use torna aasan ho jata hai. Group mein neeche metal ion bara hota hai, us ki polarizing power kam hoti hai, is liye carbonates zyada stable hote hain aur unhen torne ke liye zyada garmi chahiye.

blocks.alt: Do khaake. Oopar: chhota laal Mg2+ ion aur us ke saath carbonate ka hara teen patti wala electron badal (cloud), jis ka ion ki taraf wala hissa ion ki taraf khinch kar dashed bahari lakeer se aage nikal gaya hai. Neeche: bara neela Ba2+ ion, jis ke saath badal taqreeban apni dashed lakeer jaisa hai.
blocks.caption: Mg2+ aur Ba2+ ions se carbonate ion ka polarisation (kitab ke be-number khaake ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dashed lakeer carbonate ion (CO₃²⁻) ka asal, be-bigra electron badal hai aur hara hissa asal badal. Chhota Mg²⁺ badal ko zor se apni taraf kheench kar bigarta hai, is liye C–O bonds kamzor ho kar MgCO₃ 540 °C par toot jata hai. Bara Ba²⁺ badal ko mushkil se bigarta hai, is liye BaCO₃ ko 1360 °C chahiye (Table 17.3). Nitrates ke saath bhi yahi hota hai.
Group 2 nitrates garam karne par toot kar metal oxide (MO), bhoori (brown) nitrogen dioxide gas (NO₂) aur oxygen gas (O₂) banate hain.
Carbonates ki tarah nitrates ki thermal stability bhi Group 2 mein neeche barhti hai. Be(NO₃)₂ sab se kam stable aur Ba(NO₃)₂ sab se zyada stable hai.
Yahan bhi polarizing power wali wajah lagu hoti hai. Group ke upar wale chhote M²⁺ ions nitrate ion (NO₃⁻) ko zyada bigarte hain, is liye yeh kam temperature par aasani se toot jata hai.

Group 2 ka koi carbonate ya nitrate kis temperature par toot'ta hai, yeh dekh kar chemists na-maloom (unknown) compounds pehchan sakte hain aur kisi khaas element ki maujoodgi pakki kar sakte hain. Tootne ka yeh pattern ionic size, charge density aur thermal stability ka aapas ka taalluq samjhata hai. Group 2 carbonates ke tootne ke temperatures Table 17.3 mein hain.

blocks.prompt: a) Group 1 aur Group 2 metals ke do physical farq batayein.
blocks.explanation: Koi do: Group 2 metals zyada sakht hain, in ki density zyada hai, aur in ke melting/boiling points zyada hain (Table 17.2).

blocks.prompt: b) Group 1 oxide aur Group 2 oxide ka general formula likhein.
blocks.explanation: Group 1: M₂O (maslan Na₂O). Group 2: MO (maslan CaO).

blocks.prompt: c) SrCO₃ ke thermal decomposition ki balanced equation likhein.
d) Batayein ke magnesium carbonate calcium carbonate se thermally kam stable kyun hai.
blocks.explanation: Mg²⁺ (65 pm) Ca²⁺ (99 pm) se chhota hai, is liye us ki charge density aur polarizing power zyada hai. Yeh carbonate ion ko zyada bigar kar us ke bonds kamzor karta hai, is liye MgCO₃ 540 °C par aur CaCO₃ 900 °C par toot'ta hai.

blocks.prompt: e) i) magnesium nitrate aur ii) barium nitrate ke thermal decomposition ki equations likhein. In mein se kaun kam temperature par toot'ta hai?
blocks.explanation: i) 2Mg(NO₃)₂(s) → 2MgO(s) + 4NO₂(g) + O₂(g). ii) 2Ba(NO₃)₂(s) → 2BaO(s) + 4NO₂(g) + O₂(g). Magnesium nitrate kam temperature par toot'ta hai, kyunke chhota Mg²⁺ nitrate ion ko zyada polarize karta hai.

items: Carbonate: MCO₃ → MO + CO₂. Nitrate: 2M(NO₃)₂ → 2MO + 4NO₂ + O₂.
Thermal stability neeche barhti hai: BeCO₃ 250 °C se BaCO₃ 1360 °C tak.
Wajah: chhote M²⁺ ki polarizing power zyada, anion jaldi toot'ta hai.
